record.source_text: (1) The Federal Minister of Finance may exempt certain groups of — exclusively manual workers, — employees who carry out statistical surveys for regional authorities, — employees in the occupational categories of musicians, stage performers, artists and film makers who are employed continuously for not more than one week, from the obligation to submit a wage tax card and, deviating from Sections 57 to 66, 71, 74 and 75, permit the withholding and remittance of wage tax at a flat-rate amount.
